item.title: MarkItDown utility converts files to Markdown for LLM pipelines
item.description:
MarkItDown utility converts files to Markdown for LLM pipelines

MarkItDown, a lightweight Python utility, enables conversion of many file types into Markdown for use with large language models and text‑analysis pipelines. ## 🔍 Overview - Lightweight Python utility for converting various files to Markdown for use with LLMs and related text analysis pipelines. - Most comparable to textract, but focused on preserving important document structure and content as Markdown (headings, lists, tables, links, etc.). ## 🧩 Supported Formats - PDF - PowerPoint - Word - Excel - Images (EXIF metadata and OCR) - Audio (EXIF metadata and speech transcription) - HTML - Text-based formats (CSV, JSON, XML) - ZIP files (iterates over contents) - YouTube URLs - EPubs ## ⚙️ Optional Dependencies | Extra | Installs | |—|—| | all | all optional dependencies | | pptx | dependencies for PowerPoint files | | docx | dependencies for Word files | | xlsx | dependencies for Excel files | | xls | dependencies for older Excel files | | pdf | dependencies for PDF files | | outlook | dependencies for Outlook messages | | az-doc-intel | dependencies for Azure Document Intelligence | | az-content-understanding | dependencies for Azure Content Understanding | | audio-transcription | dependencies for audio transcription of wav and mp3 files | | youtube-transcription | dependencies for fetching YouTube video transcription | ## 🚀 Availability - Requires Python 3.10 or higher. - Install with pip: pip install 'markitdown[all]'. ## 💡 Extensibility - Supports 3rd‑party plugins. - The markitdown-ocr plugin adds OCR support to PDF, DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX converters, extracting text from embedded images using LLM Vision.
